Former Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina Plans December Return Amid Legal Challenges

Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has announced plans to return to Bangladesh in December, stating she is prepared to face arrest or even death. Her planned return comes as she reportedly faces legal challenges and a potential death sentence. The move has generated discussion about its implications for Bangladesh's political landscape and its relationship with India.
